WITH account_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    AVG(amount) as avg_transaction_amount
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(transaction_count) as avg_trans_count
  FROM account_stats
)
SELECT 
  a.account_id,
  a.avg_transaction_amount,
  a.transaction_count,
  a.transaction_count / g.avg_trans_count as ratio
FROM account_stats a
CROSS JOIN global_avg g
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
